No value differs on a completed return.

Ruling: model error; on x1sche.f7.royalty_magi the reply leaves the royalty (2,400) out of modified AGI (98,600 vs the project's 101,000), but i8582 p. 11, Line 6: 'Include in modified adjusted gross income any portfolio income and expenses that are clearly and directly allocable to portfolio income' (royalties are portfolio income); it also reads person.plan, unanswered on classm.f8582.2, and hides line 6 on a Part II return (x1sche.f10.part5) and shows it under the filing exception.

Ruling: model error; inherits line 6's exclusion of royalty income from modified AGI (x1sche.f7.royalty_magi: line 7 51,400 vs 49,000; i8582 p. 11, Line 6, 'Include ... any portfolio income'), hides the line on a Part II return and refuses where the project computes. The project-unknown witnesses are generated returns with no rental (scope.rental false), where Form 8582 is not filed and the $royalty roster is not asked: nothing on those completed returns reads the line.
